title: Maykito Large Cookie Cutters Set 12 Pieces Stainless Steel Winter Baking Shapes
features: Twelve-piece stainless cookie cutter set with winter shapes such as tree, snowflake, star, house, snowman, gingerbread, reindeer, candy cane, and glove designs.
Made of premium stainless steel—strong, shape-holding, and rust resistant with proper care.
Care tip: hand wash and wipe dry after each use to help prevent rust and maximize life.
Gift-ready boxed packaging for convenient storage and family gifting.
Use for cookie dough, fondant, soft fruits, bread, sandwiches, cheese, or craft clay; also works as a pancake mold.
